blocks.title: if-elif-else statement
blocks.text: The if-elif-else statement checks several conditions in turn and runs the block of the first one that is true; else runs if none is true.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)

blocks.text: With weather = "cloudy", neither condition is true, so the program prints "Enjoy your day!".
